api-reference/simulate.description: Run a Monte Carlo simulation and receive a structured decision envelope.

concepts/auto-vs-expert.title: Auto Mode vs Expert Mode
concepts/auto-vs-expert.description: Decision Engine supports two modes. You can switch between them — they use the same engine and return the same response format.

concepts/decision-envelope.title: Decision Envelope
concepts/decision-envelope.description: Every simulation returns a Decision Envelope — a structured object containing everything you need to act on the result.

concepts/distributions.title: Probability Distributions
concepts/distributions.description: In Expert Mode, you choose the distribution that best represents each variable's uncertainty. Choosing the right distribution produces more realistic simulations.

concepts/monte-carlo.title: Monte Carlo Simulation
concepts/monte-carlo.description: Monte Carlo simulation is the core technology behind Decision Engine. Understanding how it works helps you design better scenarios and interpret results confidently.

index.title: Decision Engine
index.description: Monte Carlo simulation API for smarter, faster decisions.
